method.branches: valgrind cachegrind --branch-sim=yes, conditional and indirect mispredictions (Bcm + Bim) of the counted calls, per sample (D1611)
method.command: cargo measure <kernel> --merge, or cargo measure --all (the cycles and, where they are simulated, the branches)
method.cost: cycles + mispredictions x penalty of the core model (D1611, D1612)
method.cycles: llvm-mca on the reference model and the counter-model of the level, the execution counts of the counted calls from the profiler of the level (block_counts), per sample of the counted calls (D33, D68)
method.note: only the ratio of ours to the comparison on one model means something; the cycles are no hardware figures
